title: BookRush / Data Quality
description: DQ-01, DQ-02 and DQ-05. Data quality is shown as measured or explicitly not instrumented.

options.content:
### NOT_INSTRUMENTED

Outbox pending count, delivery lag and sink errors are not currently exported as approved low-cardinality metrics. They must come from behavior-owned projection/metrics (dash-07/08), not a guessed zero.

### NOT_INSTRUMENTED

Reporting watermarks and refresh status are not available until dash-09 creates the versioned projection health contract. A healthy Prometheus scrape does not prove business-data freshness.
All business rates require numerator, denominator, population, time window and attribution version. This operational dashboard intentionally does not calculate CTR or conversion.
